title: Definite integral
intro: Compare the signed integral with geometric area.

beats.spoken: Plot f of x equals x minus three on a Graphs page.
beats.coach: In Graphs, enter f₁(x) = x − 3 and press Enter. The line crosses the x-axis at x = 3.

beats.spoken: Open Menu then six: Analyze Graph then six: Integral.
This page contains one curve. If prompted on your handheld, select the curve first.
beats.coach: Only one curve is plotted here. If your calculator asks which curve, select the one you want.

beats.spoken: Type zero for the lower bound and press Enter.
beats.coach: Type 0 then Enter. The lower bound is locked and the handheld now asks for the upper bound.

beats.spoken: Type four for the upper bound and press Enter.
beats.coach: Type 4 and Enter to finish the definite integral.

beats.spoken: The integral is minus four. The contribution below the x-axis is negative.
beats.coach: The integral is exactly −4. The contribution below the axis is negative: −4.5 + 0.5 = −4.

beats.spoken: For geometric area, split where the graph crosses the axis, at x equals three.
beats.coach: Split at the sign change x = 3. Both pieces count positively when finding geometric area.

beats.spoken: Add the magnitudes: four point five below and zero point five above. Total geometric area is five.
beats.coach: The two triangular areas are 4.5 and 0.5. Add their magnitudes to get 5 square units. The LCD still shows the signed result, −4.
